name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: run_id
description: Run UUID. Matches runs.id in Postgres and run_id in the audit log.

name: agent
description: Registered agent name from agents/registry.yaml, e.g. security_sentinel.

name: tier
description: Agent tier: 0 read and report, 1 draft, 2 contact, 3 meta.

name: from_status
description: State before this transition; null for the first row of a run.

name: to_status
description: State after this transition: queued, running, awaiting_human, completed, failed or rolled_back.

name: trigger
description: What started the run: schedule, webhook, human, eval or replay.

name: idempotency_key
description: Unique key that stops duplicate runs (TM-18).

name: attempt
description: Delivery attempt of the queue message that drove this transition (pgmq read_ct).

name: error_code
description: Machine-readable failure reason when to_status is failed. Never free text from user data.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
